headline: A more consistent Nexus, with safer inventory history

changes.title: Refined navigation and visual hierarchy
changes.detail: Unified the iPhone-first screen hierarchy, navigation rows, disclosures, button geometry and sheet actions across Today, Trends, Profile, Settings and related detail screens.

changes.title: Calendar day logs and all logs
changes.detail: Added the approved Calendar day-view and All Logs workflow while preserving logged dates, details, history and editing.

changes.title: Cleaner Protocol and Plans cards
changes.detail: Reduced card density, refined disclosure and action placement, and preserved existing protocol schedules, histories and actions.

changes.title: Unified kit and Supplies experience
changes.detail: Aligned premixed and standard kit cards, vial details, inventory actions, supply presentation and guided editing to the approved design language.

changes.title: Consistent blend dosing and inventory links
changes.detail: Kept premixed blends in standard Log Dose and kit workflows with explicit source transaction tracking and preserved historical ingredient associations.

changes.title: Protect historical prepared doses from uncertain refunds
changes.detail: Deletion is blocked when an unused prepared batch lacks a verifiable original kit, vial or blend transaction. The original record and stock remain unchanged rather than crediting the currently open vial.

changes.title: Clearer What's New and update history
changes.detail: Consolidated in-app release history presentation and prepared notices that appear only for verified published releases.

changes.title: More consistent touch targets and contrast safeguards
changes.detail: Improved selected buttons, modal actions, spacing and focus presentation; light-theme contrast triage and VoiceOver acceptance remain incomplete.

dataImpact: No destructive migrations or historical record rewrites. Existing production browser storage, check-ins, schedules, logged doses, prepared batches, vial histories, protocols, backups and settings remain protected. Ambiguous historical source allocations are preserved and unsafe prepared-batch deletion is blocked.
limitations: Some legacy prepared batches lack exact historical source IDs and require manual review before deletion or inventory return.
User-reported physical iPhone acceptance covers the isolated orphan-source warning (12/12), not every screen or VoiceOver.
Light-mode automated contrast scan identifies 58 candidates needing validated background-aware WCAG AA triage; broad accessibility acceptance remains pending.
The manifest is a release candidate only: publication status remains unverified until approved merge, Cloudflare asset parity and a follow-up publication update.
